chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Abdiias; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Edom; mi' dhɨr naak gu Jawatan Dios mattuda' chɨbɨɨp; jano' ba' jix búup bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ali' tu' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam gu vaak na jix bhai'; na tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu si'avag gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' ɨ'xkum gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham jix duñia' tu' ba'k tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu kutun kavɨk tu'x gu Esauu tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' bhaan tu'; na gu takarui' jix dhaas jix duñia' bɨtaa'n tu'; jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mamatdagɨm gu Edom gu kavɨk gu Esauu.
Jano' ba' jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu Temaan ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' bɨx gu chio'ñ ka't gu kavɨk gu Esauu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' xibhɨk gu Jakob tu' gu ñi'ook xi'ɨraam ka' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh kua' tu' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham kiki'ñgob mamai'chɨk bhaan gu Jerusalem tu' gio na ja'p maa'n.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tɨɨgɨk gu tanoolh xibhɨk gu tanoolh ka't; gio ba' cham tu' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu tanoolh tu' gu chin gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'mi'ñ ki'ñgob gu ja'tkam gu tanoolh; gio ba' cham tu' tu jiim cham bhai' gu tanoolh tu' baas gu novɨ xoi'kam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' kooda'; gio ba' tu' dhagia' gu tanoolh.
Na gu' na gu' mia'n gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' na ja'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu kavɨk i'i bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' i'i ka't na ja'p tu' cham jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' gu kavɨk gu Sioon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dodhia' ka't jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Jakob gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Jakob ka't gu tai gu vaak gu Josee ka't mɨmɨim gu vaak gu Esauu dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' gu vaak gu Esauu na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' saagi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Esauu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Palestinos; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gio vaak ja'tkam gu Epraim vaak ja'tkam gu Samaria; mi' dhɨr gu Benjamiin gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Kananeos bɨɨx ka'm gu Sarepta; gio ba' gu Jerusalem gu Separad gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' aajim boosolh gu kavɨk gu Sioon na ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Esauu; gio ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu Jawatan Dios.
